text: Space station scene! Background: dark navy rectangle, 780 by 480, at 400,250, background layer, called Space.
Big gray hexagon in the middle, name it Core.
Label Core "ORBITAL 7"
Add a blue rectangle 120 by 40 left of Core called PanelL
and a blue rectangle 120 by 40 on the right side of Core, PanelR
attach both panels to Core with plain lines
Make PanelL cyan, no wait, both panels
Put a small white triangle on top of Core for the dish, name it Dish.
Dock: medium teal square under Core.
join Dock to Core with a gray line
Now the planet: huge orange circle at 110,410, call it PlanetBall.
Ring around it: orange ellipse, outline only, 190 by 44, at 110,410, named Ring.
bring PlanetBall in front of the ring
Group PlanetBall and Ring, call it Planet.
Is PlanetBall in the bottom left?
Rocket on the left: white rectangle 40 by 90 at 120,150 named Hull
red nose cone, small triangle at 120,82, call it Nose
tiny orange star for the flame at 120,213 called Flame
Hull, Nose, Flame: group them as Rocket
The rocket is coming in to dock: dashed arrow from Nose to Dock, label it "docking"
How many connections does Core have?
What is connected to Dock?
Sprinkle six tiny yellow stars in a grid in the top right.
One more star, a small white one, at 300,60.
Moon: small gray circle named Moon at 560,80
Which shape is closest to the moon?
astronaut! small white circle named Helmet at 680,346
suit: white rectangle 40 by 50 at 680,400, name Suit
Please group Helmet and Suit and name the group Astro.
dotted line from Suit to Dock, that's the tether
Give the helmet a cyan outline
Move Astro up 40
Is Helmet above Suit?
swap PanelL and PanelR
What color is PanelR?
Write "Day 214 in orbit" in the bottom right
make that text cyan and small
Add a tiny red circle as a beacon, 20 px above Dish.
rename it Beacon
connect Beacon to Dish with a line
how many stars are there?
delete the white star
Which shape is the biggest? I bet it's the planet.
Remove the label from the docking arrow
Turn the dish into a diamond
Are there any cycles in these connections?
Undo the diamond
Done, the station looks great.
